The '''Pouffra system''' was located in the [[Rolion sector/Legends|Rolion sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the location of<ref name="Sports">{{SW|url=news/this-is-podracing-sports-in-the-star-wars-galaxy-part-1|series=Sports in the Star Wars Galaxy|text=Part 1: This Is Podracing|nolive=1}}</ref> the [[Pouffra Circuit]], a relatively safe<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|39|Pouffra Circuit}}</ref> amateur<ref name="NEGTC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] course in which the beginner [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|racer]] [[Ben Quadinaros/Legends|Ben Quadinaros]] at one point participated.<ref name="CSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Pouffra [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square Q-7.<ref name="TEA" /> A map of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] included in the article "[[Sports in the Star Wars Galaxy|This Is Podracing: Sports in the ''Star Wars'' Galaxy, Part 1]]," which was authored by [[Tim Veekhoven]] and [[Sander de Lange]] and published on [[StarWars.com]] on [[March 26]], [[2014]], erroneously indicated that the system was located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="Sports" />
